answers.assumption_check: Assumed: a tooth that reads UNRAN prints FAIL with the text UNRAN in the stdout the tester already parses into teeth_red; unmeasured whether a Linux reseal records those as teeth_red, which the proof's fixture measures. 2026-11-20 on akiendell (Windows): cc_0's Linux landing of 80a2-fix (a2f477928) resealed bin/proofs/test_cairn_runs_from_cmd_with_no_bash.py on Linux, where teeth 1 and 3 read UNRAN (cairn.cmd is Windows-only), and persist_validation REPLACED my green 3 of 3 Windows seal with that red. The replacement voided 380d524e6e9c's hollow evidence and left the proof red on main until I resealed on Windows (bdce17bf1) and re-ran the hollow (1e958634f). Outline 9.4.8.1 already reads a not-run tooth as not-run, never red; the seal write has no such reading.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs and has: reseal() in reseal.py around its two persist_validation calls, read_validations and source_fingerprint, the three clauses, and the UNRAN text the proofs print.
answers.children: none, because the work is one guard in reseal.py and its proof
answers.collision_check: No real collision. 50ac45cde4dd is the reader; this is the writer, distinct addresses (verdict.py vs reseal.py).
answers.falsifier_check: Falsifier: a fixture proof with a green Windows seal, resealed on Linux with every failing tooth UNRAN, keeps the seal file byte-identical and the result says the seal was kept and why / a reseal where a tooth actually FAILs still writes red over the green seal / a reseal over a standing seal on other bytes (fingerprint differs) writes as before. Horizon: the first reseal after landing.
answers.gates_bound: proved (Law 8: a proof a hollow build could not pass) and feeds back to origin on failure (Law 3): PROVEME runs the proof under the tester's seal on Linux; a red returns the ticket to FIXME.
answers.missing_check: Not wrapped: the same loss on a run_proof seal (the other persist call) is left for the builder to measure; a stale Windows seal after the source changes is not kept, by design.
answers.questions: none, because the shape is a CC-answerable hypothesis the proof measures, per cairn/devices/tester/intention+why.json
answers.title: a reseal on a host that cannot run a tooth does not replace a seal from a host that can
